name: Braojos (Spain)
description: Green field with a red rectangle at the centre charged with the crowned municipal arms of Braojos (a tower on green and a tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Braojos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
